tenderSchedule.title: Re-tender of Procurement of 222 Tins 15 Kgs. each of KCOGF Safal or equivalent Brand Coconut oil
tenderSchedule.description: Re-tender Procurement of 222 Tins 15 Kgs. each of KCOGF Safal or equivalent Brand Coconut oil for SWF Mysore

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have experience in the similar coconut oil supply for a minimum period of 2 years out of past 3 years in any Public Sector/Govt/Private sector/s. relevant documentary evidence like copies of work order of satisfactorily work completion certificate should be furnished.

The tenderer should have a minimum turnover of Rs.15.00 Lakhs per annum in any 2 of the past 3 years and documentary proof /certification from a Chartered Accountant in support of the same as audited profit &loss account/balance sheet will have to be provided

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: PAN/GST: The tenderer should possess PAN Card, Goods Service Tax Registration Number and produce the copies of the documents while submitting the tender.

The tenderer shall furnish the address of the Head Office, Branch Office and the Works (Factory) with contact Nos., email id etc. The bidder shall also submit the documentary proof in support of their capability to supply the quantity required
